title: Settings
intro: Keys are never shown: you can only replace them. Other variables (DATA_DIR, LOG_LEVEL…) live only in the .env. This connector never publishes: everything stays as draft.

language.title: Language
language.intro: Language of the interface. Applied right away, even while jobs are running.
language.label: Interface language

ai.title: AI
ai.intro: The test makes a minimal call to the model (1 token).

pixabay.title: Pixabay
pixabay.intro: Free stock photos. The key is issued right away when you sign up. Optional.

pexels.title: Pexels
pexels.intro: Fallback when Unsplash runs out of quota. Optional.

openverse.title: Openverse
openverse.intro: Creative Commons photos (Flickr, Wikimedia…). Works without credentials (200 requests a day). With them, you get more quota. Attribution always goes in the caption.

wikimedia.title: Wikimedia Commons
wikimedia.intro: Wikipedia's images: people, places, logos and technical or historical topics. No key needed. The attribution always goes in the caption.

gsc.title: Google Search Console
gsc.intro: Optional, for the Ideas page: the searches where your blog almost reaches the first page. Create a service account in Google Cloud, enable the Search Console API, download its JSON key and add its email as a user of the property in Search Console.

bing.title: Bing Webmaster Tools
bing.intro: Optional, for the Ideas page: adds Bing searches (Bing also powers Copilot and part of ChatGPT search) to Google's. Generate the API key in Bing Webmaster → Settings → API access. If you already use Search Console, you can import the site from there.

GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.label: Admin API Key
GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.help: Format id:secret (Ghost → Integrations). The Content API Key won't work.

AI_PROVIDER.label: Provider
AI_PROVIDER.help: openai-compatible works for OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio…

AI_MODEL.label: Main model
AI_MODEL.help: Used for every step unless you pick another one below. Required with openai-compatible.

AI_BASE_URL.label: Base URL
AI_BASE_URL.help: Empty = the provider's. Required with openai-compatible (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1).

AI_MODEL_WRITER.label: Writing the post
AI_MODEL_WRITER.help: Writes and improves the article text. The step where quality matters most.

AI_MODEL_SEO.label: SEO
AI_MODEL_SEO.help: Meta title, description, slug, tags and excerpt. A small model is usually enough.

AI_MODEL_IMAGE.label: Featured image
AI_MODEL_IMAGE.help: Decides what photo to look for. A small model is usually enough.

AI_MODEL_RESOLVE.label: Answering pending questions
AI_MODEL_RESOLVE.help: Rewrites the parts of the text that depended on your answers.

AI_PRICES.label: Prices (USD per million tokens)
AI_PRICES.help: model=input/output, comma-separated. Without a price, the cost shows as unknown. deepseek-flash is built in.

IMAGE_SOURCES_ORDER.label: Source order
IMAGE_SOURCES_ORDER.help: The first one is tried. If it has no key, runs out of quota or finds nothing, the next one is used.

OPENVERSE_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
OPENVERSE_CLIENT_ID.help: Optional: raises the 200/day limit. Get one with "Register app".

OPENVERSE_LICENSES.label: Allowed licenses
OPENVERSE_LICENSES.help: Comma-separated: cc0, pdm, by, by-sa. by-sa requires sharing derived images under the same license.

WIKIMEDIA_LICENSES.label: Allowed licenses
WIKIMEDIA_LICENSES.help: Comma-separated: cc0, pdm, by, by-sa. by-sa requires sharing derived images under the same license.

GSC_SITE_URL.label: Property
GSC_SITE_URL.help: As shown in Search Console: sc-domain:yourdomain.com or https://yourdomain.com/

GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.label: Service account key
GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.help: Path to the JSON file (recommended) or its content. Read-only use.

BING_SITE_URL.label: Site
BING_SITE_URL.help: The site URL as shown in Bing Webmaster: https://yourdomain.com/

INTERNAL_LINKS.label: Suggest internal links
INTERNAL_LINKS.help: The writer may link 1 to 3 posts already published on your blog that cover the same topic.

AUTO_PLAN_TIME.label: Plan every night at
AUTO_PLAN_TIME.help: Time (HH:MM, local) to plan only the new drafts, the ones never planned. It only plans: nothing is applied to Ghost. Empty = off. If the panel was off at that time, it runs when it starts later that day.

AUTO_PLAN_MAX.label: Max drafts per night
AUTO_PLAN_MAX.help: Own cap for the nightly plan, besides the daily spending cap. Default 3.

GITHUB_TOKEN.label: GitHub token
GITHUB_TOKEN.help: Optional. When reading sources from github.com (e.g. an organization's most-starred repos) it raises the limit from 60 to 5000 requests/hour. A token with no permissions is enough.

SITE_CONTEXT.label: Site context
SITE_CONTEXT.help: Passed to the agents: what the blog is about, tone, audience.

AI_DAILY_BUDGET_USD.label: Daily spending cap (USD)
AI_DAILY_BUDGET_USD.help: Stops starting new AI work once the last 24 hours reach this amount. 0 = no cap. A post already running can finish and go slightly over. Models without a price count as $0.

secret.keep: Leave empty to keep the current one.
secret.ownerOnly: Only the owner can see or change keys.
secret.ownerOnlyEndpoint: Only the owner can change it: it decides where the keys are sent.

draftFilter.notTag: All except those with a tag
draftFilter.tagHelp: Ghost internal tags (those starting with #) have the slug hash-…: #review is hash-review.
draftFilter.nqlHelp: Always limited to drafts: even if the filter doesn't say so, published posts are never processed. NQL syntax: Ghost docs.

locked.one: A job is running: wait for it to finish to save.
locked.other: {count} jobs are running: wait for them to finish to save.

form.validated: Everything is validated before writing {path}. If anything is invalid, nothing is saved. Applied without restarting.

openverse.title: Register the app with Openverse
openverse.intro: This data is sent to api.openverse.org. Openverse returns a client ID and a secret, saved straight to your .env (they can't be looked up again). You'll get an email: until you confirm it, the quota is the same as without credentials.
openverse.name: App name
openverse.nameHelp: Must be unique across all of Openverse.
openverse.defaultDescription: Finds openly licensed featured images for the posts on my Ghost blog, with attribution in the caption.

chart.title: Spend per day, last {count} days
chart.empty: No AI spend in the last {count} days.

prompts.title: Base prompts
prompts.intro: They affect all future plans. Each save keeps the previous version in the history.

info.seo.system: Meta title, meta description and excerpt
info.image.system: Picks or generates the featured image
info.ideas.system: Suggests new topics from your posts and Search Console
info.snippet.system: Proposes Google titles and descriptions for published posts with few clicks

index.title: Local index
index.help: Reindex if the cost or the dashboard don't match the saved runs. No run is deleted.

notices.nothing: There were no changes to save.
notices.openverse: App registered with Openverse and credentials saved. Check your email and confirm the address. Then "Test connection" in Openverse will show your real quota.

errors.ovExists: credentials already exist. Check "replace" to register another app
errors.ovNotSaved: registered, but the .env couldn't be written ({error}). Copy OPENVERSE_CLIENT_ID={id} and OPENVERSE_CLIENT_SECRET={secret} into your .env now: they can't be recovered

model.failed: Couldn't load the provider's models ({message}). Choose "Other" and type the name.
model.perAgentIntro: Each step of a plan is a separate call to the AI. By default, all of them use the main model. Here you can pick another one for a step, e.g. a cheaper model for SEO and the image search, and the best one for writing.

keyLink.ghost: Create a key in Ghost → Settings → Integrations
keyLink.unsplash: Create an Unsplash app (free) and copy its Access Key
keyLink.pixabay: Get your free Pixabay API key (shown in its docs once you sign in)
keyLink.pexels: Get a free Pexels API key
keyLink.github: Create a token on GitHub (no permissions needed)
keyLink.gsc: How to create the service account
keyLink.bing: Generate the API key in Bing Webmaster

transfer.title: Export / import
transfer.intro: What only exists in this panel, to move it to another installation or keep it: plans and chosen images, edited prompts, settings (without keys), notes and assignments, ideas, title/meta changes and what your reviews taught. The drafts stay in Ghost.
transfer.never: It never includes users, passwords, 2FA or keys.
transfer.fullBackup: The full backup (with users, 2FA and, if you want, the keys) is only made on the server: ghost-connector backup. To restore it, stop the panel and extract it into {dir}.

preview.title: Review the import
preview.meta: Exported from {site} on {time}{by}. Choose what to bring in: it's added to what's here and nothing is ever deleted.
preview.otherSite: This export comes from another site ({site}). Plans, notes and assignments refer to that site's posts: here they only help if the posts have the same ids (e.g. the same Ghost under another URL).

plans.title: Plans and images
plans.body: {newRuns} new plans and {newImages} images. {existingRuns} were already here and are left as they are.

prompts.title: Edited prompts
prompts.body: Replaces: {list}. A revision is kept so you can go back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Changes {count} settings (never keys nor the connection to Ghost, Search Console or Bing):

team.title: Notes and assignments
team.skipped: {count} assignments are skipped: their user doesn't exist here or the post already has someone.

ideas.title: Ideas and title/meta changes
ideas.body: {history} dismissed or used ideas and {snippets} title/meta changes.

learning.title: Review learning
learning.body: {count} review decisions (the suggestions for the writer prompt).

preview.allHere: Nothing to import: everything in this file is already here.

errors.notExport: That file is not a Ghost Connector export.
errors.newerVersion: The export comes from a newer Ghost Connector: update this panel first.
errors.expired: The import expired (30 min). Upload the file again.
errors.jobs: Jobs are running: wait for them to finish before importing settings.
